Description of the accident (claimant's words)
I was backing out of a parking space at a shopping center in Sugar Land, Texas, moving slowly with my mirrors
checked, when the other vehicle came around the end of the row and struck the rear passenger side of my car. The
impact was not severe, but my head snapped against the window frame and I felt dizzy and nauseous within minutes.
I was taken to an urgent care clinic, where I was told I had a concussion and was advised to rest and avoid screens
for several days. Since then I have had headaches and trouble concentrating. Looking back, I have remembered a
few smaller details, such as the color of the other car and the position of a shopping cart near my door, but the core of
what happened has not changed since I first described it. I am the named driver on this policy and have provided my
insurance information below.
